title: Cost-Tuning Advisor: regression validators using golden-sets & dynamic thresholds
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Automated cost optimizations (batching / KV cache / quantization) reduce token spend but occasionally introduce subtle quality regressions that only appear at scale or on specific prompt families. Current cost-tuner autopilot can suggest and apply config changes but lacks a standardized, automated validation pipeline to gate changes by quality impact. This ticket implements a Cost-Tuning Advisor that runs targeted eval suites (golden prompts + representative traffic samples) and enforces dynamic acceptance thresholds before allowing automated apply or triggering an automatic rollback.
design_summary: Introduce a validation layer in the cost-tuner workflow: 1) For any proposed config delta (batch size, cache TTL, quantization profile) the advisor spins up a canary with a safe traffic slice and runs a battery of checks: golden-prompt regression set, representative sampled traffic eval, and structured-output correctness tests. 2) Compute metrics: embedding-similarity (cosine) against baseline, categorical/structured F1, hallucination heuristics (entity-drop rate), latency / token-cost delta. 3) Compare against dynamic thresholds that scale with magnitude of cost change; e.g., smaller cost gains allowed smaller tolerance. 4) Require statistical significance via bootstrap (p < 0.05) for detected regressions. 5) If a change fails, prevent apply and open a rollback/triage runbook. 6) If it passes, allow staged rollout with auto-rollback windows and post-rollout monitoring hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor runs automatically for any config proposals from cost-tuner (hosted or dedicated) and produces an evaluation report within target SLA (<= 30 minutes for typical 2k golden-set).

Decision rules enforce: embedding cosine mean >= baseline - dynamic_delta, structured F1 drop <= dynamic_delta_f1, and p-value >= 0.05 for no-regression decision. Dynamic deltas are documented and computed from config delta magnitude.
Canary rollout automation: 1% traffic baseline with at least 2k golden prompts executed; auto-rollback triggers if any primary metric crosses emergency thresholds within first hour.
Integration tests simulate three failure modes (semantic drift, entity drop, latency regressions) and produce deterministic fail/pass signals in CI.
Telemetry events emitted: cost_tuner.validate.start, cost_tuner.validate.result, cost_tuner.apply.start, cost_tuner.rollback.triggered, cost_tuner.rollback.completed.
Runbook and Slack alert template created; incident path documented in confluence link provided below.
testing_plan: 1) Unit tests for threshold calculator and bootstrap significance util. 2) Synthetic CI job: run cost-tuner proposal against a seeded model variant that we know induces a controlled 3% embedding drift and assert fail. 3) Integration canary in staging connecting to runtime-1.20 with 2k golden prompts and sampled customer queries (anonymized). 4) Load test to validate evaluator completes within 30 minutes under typical dataset sizes.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): enable advisor for cost-tuner proposals from internal test harness only. Phase 2 (limited prod): enable advisor for dedicated accounts labeled 'cost-beta' and apply canary 1% traffic policy. Phase 3 (wider prod): default advisor gating for automated applies after 4+ successful canaries and ops sign-off.
decisions: Use embedding-cosine (SentenceTransformers) as primary semantic similarity signal for open text regressions; fallback to structured F1 where ground-truth exists.
Dynamic threshold function: delta = base_tolerance + alpha * abs(percent_cost_reduction) where alpha tuned in experiment; start alpha=0.8.
Statistical test: bootstrap resampling of embedding scores to compute 95% CI and p-value against baseline sample.
Automatic rollback policy: immediate rollback if any emergency metric (entity-drop-rate > 2x baseline OR structured F1 drop > 5 absolute points) is observed during canary window.
Keep golden prompt set curated by PM + research; update cadence quarterly or when new customer domain added.
All canary eval results persisted to S3 with stable keys to enable later audits and model comparisons.
